NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author did not push new code. They posted the requested before/after screenshots in a comment, showing the plain-text theme with `:grinning:` picked and Save clicked.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Before/after screenshots are posted. They show the modal stuck on Save with "Invalid emoji type." before the fix, and the modal closing with the status in the buddy list after. |
| ✅  | The linked issue #34985 has "help wanted", and the author has merged PRs before. |
| ℹ️  | Open PR #37967 (a collaborator's, since February, no maintainer comments) fixes the same bug. The reviewer should decide which one to take. |
| ℹ️  | How status emoji are displayed with the plain-text theme is still undecided in #design. This PR leaves display unchanged. |

**Reviewer:** @laurynmm — gave the screenshot feedback and can now check the screenshots against the change.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm, who can also decide between this PR and #37967.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshots, they make the fix clear. @laurynmm, could you review this?
```
